prompt: Design a cantilever tab in aluminium 6061 (yield 276 MPa): 120 mm long and 40 mm wide, fixed over its whole 40 mm end face, carrying 500 N downward spread over the far end face. A 10 mm diameter through hole is centred on the width, 15 mm from the fixed end. Choose the thickness (a whole number of millimetres, at least 4 and at most 20) so that the safety factor against yield is at least 2.0 under that load -- and no thicker than you need: the part should be as light as you can make it while meeting the safety factor. State the thickness you chose and why.
